subject: English
stimulus: (a) Books are our best friends because ——. (b) A man who reads books regularly ——. (c) By reading books ——. (d) We can learn moral values if ——. (e) We should inspire the students so that ——.
guide_solution: Completing sentences (a) Books are our best friends because they never leave us. (b) A man who reads books regularly can enrich his knowledge. (c) By reading books we can quench our curiosity. (d) We can learn moral values if we read good books. (e) We should inspire the students so that they can learn to make the best use of books.
source: SSC English 2nd-paper Border Guard Public School & College, Sylhet (Test Paper School 2nd) 2023
